rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person or situation free from blame, including legal innocence; a specifically legal verdict is more exactly 無罪.

example.english: He is innocent, so stop blaming him.
example.traditional: 佢係無辜嘅，唔好再怪佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 mou4 gu1 ge3 m4 hou2 zoi3 gwaai3 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when the action or mistake was not intentional and the person did not mean any harm.

example.english: It was an innocent mistake—I didn't tear your book on purpose.
example.traditional: 我唔係有心整爛你本書㗎，真係無心之失。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 zing2 laan6 nei5 bun2 syu1 gaa3 zan1 hai6 mou4 sam1 zi1 sat1

rows.note: Use this for someone who is naive, artless, or inexperienced rather than morally or legally blameless.

example.english: You're still so innocent, thinking money can solve every problem.
example.traditional: 你仲咁天真，以為畀錢就可以解決晒所有問題。
example.jyutping: nei5 zung6 gam3 tin1 zan1 ji5 wai4 bei2 cin2 zau6 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 saai3 so2 jau5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for something that causes no harm and is harmless or innocuous.

example.english: This is an innocent herbal drink, so you don't need to worry about having a little.
example.traditional: 呢種草藥好冇害，飲少少唔使擔心。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 cou2 joek6 hou2 mou5 hoi6 jam2 siu2 siu2 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
